entries.clue: Two small wooden crosspieces balanced in grooves atop the three posts
Silks and lace kept back for a cool, gentle cycle of their own
Two slices with marmalade between, kept beneath a hat for emergencies
Long unblinking look, the hard sort Aunt Lucy taught for use on rude adults
One on duty at a petrol pump, a cloakroom or a row of washers
Member of the side out in the middle, there to stop runs and hold catches
Bar, flake or liquid that lifts grease and grime out of cloth
Stitched ridge circling the ball, landed on deliberately by quick men
Hooded blue duffle, bought for a new arrival on a family shopping trip
Coin spun by the captains, its winner choosing whether to bat or bowl
Hedged tangle of paths at Hampton Court, where a bear shook off a crowd
Second flood of clean water that carries the lather away
